subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Mihir's ability to think outside ____________ always gives our team the upper hand when tackling complex problems.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"think outside the box"** means to think creatively and unconventionally, often finding new solutions to problems. (रचनात्मक और अपरंपरागत रूप से सोचना)

 
 
• **Example: **We need to **think outside the box** to come up with a solution to this problem.
 
 
 
• **"Box"** in this context is a **metaphor** for conventional and limited thinking. (बॉक्स)
 
 
• **Example: **To innovate, one must step out of the **box** and explore new ideas.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Room** (कमरा): A space that can be occupied or where something can be done.

 
 
• **Example: **She rearranged the furniture in her **room** to make more space.
 
 
 
• **Cupboard** (अलमारी): A piece of furniture with doors and shelves used for storing items.
 
 
• **Example: **He kept all his supplies in the** cupboard.**
 
 
 
• **Bowl** (कटोरा): A round, deep dish used for food or liquid.
 
 
• **Example: **She served the soup in a large** bowl.**
 
 

45:Tb91,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
